title: Fourier coefficients under the sign-cube identification
statement: Let $f\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ and $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The vector Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\gamma$ equals the Fourier coefficient, on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$, of the function obtained by transporting $f$ through the coordinatewise identification of binary vectors with signs, at the monomial indexed by the support of $\gamma$.
